Jordan K: Hey team — last-minute request: my flight got delayed, need coverage for Sat 22:00-02:00 PST (4h). I can swap and take Sun next week 09:00-13:00 instead.
Jordan K: Quick handoff notes: there’s a maintenance window in us-west Sat 00:30-01:30 that may reduce spare capacity; watch for token-latency spikes and KV cache evictions. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/oncall-handbook#kv-cache and quick checklist in the gist below.
Mina C: I can cover Sat 23:00-02:00 (last 3h) but not the 22:00-23:00 hour. Would splitting work?
Sophie L: I can take the full Sat 22:00-02:00 if that helps. I’ll own the handoff and annotate the runbook with the maintenance window. :thumbsup:
DevOps: FYI infra team scheduled a kernel/security update that night — expect brief NTP jitter during 00:25-00:40 and a rolling driver reload 00:40-01:10. Autoscaler should keep up but keep an eye on queue length; if queue grows > 200, perform model fallback per policy.
oncall-bot: Fallback policy triggered -> switch to model-small-v2 for new requests; see https://redwood/policies/fallbacks. To trigger manual failover: `curl -X POST /api/failover -d '{"target":"model-small-v2"}'` (requires infra oncall token).
Jordan K: Thanks — Sophie, amazing if you can take full shift. I’ve uploaded a short checklist and a few local debug commands to the gist: https://gist.github.com/jk/oncall-sat-checks. Key items: check KV-eviction logs (`/var/log/kv-evict.log`), monitor token-latency dashboard, and verify model fallback toggles.
Sophie L: Got it. I added the calendar event and will ping here 30m before shift starts. I’ll also set up a temporary alert for queue length + latency.
Mina C: Thanks both — if anything changes I can fill the 22:00-23:00 slot. Otherwise I’ll be standby.
Jordan K: Appreciate it, Sophie. Leaving the thread open for any last-minute notes. :pray:
